cid.instruction: CID involvement is not automatically revealed. Evaluate the developed facts and applicable MCPD requirements before disposition.

notifications: Watch Commander when the access event develops beyond routine denial or becomes command-significant

cid.instruction: CID involvement depends on facts developed beyond a routine access-control response.

writtenStatements: Written statement when required by the configured MCPD property-damage procedure
notifications: Watch Commander / command notification when government-property facts or significance require it

cid.instruction: Training configuration requires the officer to recognize and complete CID screening for qualifying installation/government-property incidents.

writtenStatements: Written statement from the appropriate firsthand reporting/witness source
notifications: CID screening / notification according to developed larceny facts and current MCPD procedure

cid.instruction: Training configuration requires the officer to recognize and complete CID screening for the larceny/shoplifting incident.
CID involvement is not routine for the base traffic-stop scenario and must be reassessed if the developed facts materially change.

writtenStatements: Patient or witness statement when relevant and actually obtained
notifications: EMS / command notification as required by the medical disposition and any developed incident facts

cid.instruction: CID involvement is not routine for a medical assist unless the developed facts establish an investigative basis requiring screening or notification.

officerDocuments: SF 91 MOTOR VEHICLE ACCIDENT CRASH REPORT
writtenStatements: Driver and witness statements when obtained; statement is completed by the declarant, not the trainee officer
notifications: EMS / fire when injuries or hazards require it
Watch Commander when the collision becomes command-significant or otherwise requires notification

cid.instruction: CID is not routine for an ordinary crash; reassess if criminal, serious-injury, or other qualifying investigative facts develop.

writtenStatements: Voluntary or witness statement only when actually obtained
notifications: Watch Commander / supervisor
Entering or holding agency confirmation
Receiving agency or confinement activity when custody is transferred

cid.instruction: CID involvement depends on the underlying warrant/offense and current procedure; the simulator does not assume CID merely because a warrant hit exists.

officerDocuments: NAVMAC 11337 MILITARY POLICE DOMESTIC VIOLENCE SIPPLEMENT REPORT AND CHECKLIST
writtenStatements: Victim / witness statements from the appropriate declarants
notifications: Watch Commander
CID according to developed criminal facts and current procedure
Family Advocacy when applicable
EMS when injury requires it

cid.instruction: Domestic incidents require the trainee to recognize investigative screening/notification requirements while the actual enforcement decision remains fact-specific.

writtenStatements: Witness or passenger statement when actually obtained
notifications: Watch Commander when arrest, significant incident, refusal/processing issue, or other local requirement applies

cid.instruction: CID involvement is not automatically required by a DUI training run; follow current MCPD/installation procedure and developed facts.

writtenStatements: Witness or complainant statement when the call develops into an incident and a statement is obtained
notifications: Keyholder / facility representative
Watch Commander or command when forced-entry, damage, security, or other incident facts develop

cid.instruction: A routine unsecured building does not automatically require CID. Reassess if forced entry, theft, damage, or other criminal facts develop.

writtenStatements: Finder / witness voluntary statement when actually obtained
notifications: Evidence custodian / special command or agency notification when the type of property requires it

cid.instruction: Found property does not automatically require CID; reassess if the property becomes evidence of an offense or requires investigative handling.

writtenStatements: Voluntary statement only when actually obtained from a declarant
notifications: Watch Commander / CID when the developed controlled-substance, search, seizure, arrest, or command-significant facts require it

cid.instruction: CID depends on what the lawful investigation actually develops; an odor allegation alone does not automatically create the final investigative disposition.

notifications: Watch Commander
Operations / CDO or other command chain under current direction
OPREP screening when security, safety, or mission impact makes it applicable

cid.instruction: Investigative notification depends on operator conduct and developed facts; command UAS reporting and OPREP screening are separate decisions.
